selection: Test Set `Disclaimer Screen` 之 7 leaf（R-PMH36 之 Layer 2 定版）。**8 條 TC** —— `SWE1-HMI-PM-001-04` 依 profile §4「不同觸發即拆分」拆為 2 條（按 Accept／等待逾時）。
source_clause_basis: R-PMH50 —— 取自 spec_pdf（判讀基準，通則 3）。**不取自 SYS1 匯出** —— 本輪逐句對照證實其 7.1 漏一子句。

tcs.tc_title: Loading indicator replaced by Accept button when the system becomes ready
tcs.test_item:
During the Disclaimer screen (content per CFTS009/legal), if the system is not ready it displays “Loading…”. When the system is ready it removes “Loading…” and shows the Accept button.

(System-readiness transition on the disclaimer screen — distinguishes the not-ready state from the ready state)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is a non-Maserati application
2. The head unit is in the start-up sequence with the ignition turned on during the start-up animation
3. The disclaimer screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Observe the disclaimer screen while the system is still loading
2. Wait until the system reports ready and observe the disclaimer screen again
tcs.expected_result:
1. “Loading…” is displayed on the disclaimer screen and no Accept button is shown
2. “Loading…” is removed from the disclaimer screen and the Accept button is shown
tcs.specification_reference: Power Moding HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 2A_7.1
tcs.reasoning: P1 主要功能邏輯 —— 免責畫面之載入狀態與就緒狀態之顯示切換。**設計方法 STATE** —— 其標的為 not-ready → ready 之狀態轉換及其顯示差異。`source_clause` 取自 PDF p8 之 SU1.)（R-PMH50）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 系統就緒與否（not ready vs ready）
tcs.source_clause: SU1.) When the vehicle’s driver door is closed a startup animation will be presented (3 sec), after the animation (3 sec) a splash screen is presented timeout (1.5 each). If ignition remains off after animation, screen is black. If ignition is turned on during animation, splash screen(s) are presented (1.5 sec timeout each). The disclaimer screen will be displayed as defined by legal/CFTS009. If the system is still loading, ‘loading…’ will be displayed. Once the system is ready ‘Loading…’ will be removed and display an Accept Button. The user is able to either press the Accept to go directly to their last mode screen or wait for the screen to timeout. No timeout is provided for Maserati applications, see CFTS009. Please see the official graphics release for the verbiage, which is defined by legal, to be displayed within the disclaimer screen.

tcs.tc_title: Accept press goes directly to the last mode screen
tcs.test_item:
The system allows the user to press Accept to go directly to the last mode screen.

(Accept 按壓路徑 —— 與同 leaf 之逾時路徑區辨)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is a non-Maserati application
2. The disclaimer screen is displayed with the Accept button shown (the system is ready)
tcs.test_procedure: 1. Press the Accept button on the disclaimer screen
tcs.expected_result: 1. The disclaimer screen is removed and the last mode screen is displayed
tcs.specification_reference: Power Moding HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 2A_7.1
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: P1 主要功能邏輯。**依 profile §4「不同觸發即拆分」自 leaf `001-04` 拆出** ——「按 Accept」與「等待逾時」為兩個觸發，結果雖同而路徑不同。`source_clause` 取自 PDF p8 之 SU1.)（R-PMH50）。

tcs.tc_title: Disclaimer screen timeout acts as Accept
tcs.test_item:
The system allows the user to wait for the screen to timeout, which automatically equals Accept.

(逾時路徑 —— 與同 leaf 之 Accept 按壓路徑區辨)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is a non-Maserati application
2. The disclaimer screen is displayed with the Accept button shown (the system is ready)
tcs.test_procedure: 1. Do not press the Accept button and wait for the disclaimer screen to time out
tcs.expected_result: 1. The disclaimer screen is removed without any user input and the last mode screen is displayed, the same outcome as pressing Accept
tcs.specification_reference: Power Moding HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 2A_7.1
tcs.reasoning: P1 主要功能邏輯。**同 leaf 之第二條**（profile §4 之不同觸發）。**設計方法 STATE** —— 其標的為逾時所引發之狀態離開。⚠ **逾時之長度未載於本規格**（PDF 只寫 `wait for the screen to timeout`，未給秒數）—— 本條不斷言具體秒數，只斷言逾時後之結果。`source_clause` 取自 PDF p8 之 SU1.)（R-PMH50）。

tcs.tc_title: Maserati disclaimer screen provides no timeout
tcs.test_item:
Exception: For Maserati applications the system provides no timeout (per CFTS009); the user must manually press Accept.

(Maserati 變體之負向側 —— 逾時不得發生，與非 Maserati 之逾時路徑相對)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is a **Maserati** application
2. The disclaimer screen is displayed with the Accept button shown (the system is ready)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Do not press the Accept button and observe the disclaimer screen for a period longer than the timeout used on a non-Maserati application
2. Press the Accept button
tcs.expected_result:
1. The disclaimer screen remains displayed and does not time out
2. The disclaimer screen is removed and the last mode screen is displayed
tcs.specification_reference: Power Moding HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 2A_7.1
tcs.reasoning: P1 主要功能邏輯。**設計方法 NEG** —— 其標的為「逾時**不**發生」。變體詞 `Maserati` 逐字取自規格（profile §3.2）。⚠ 步驟 1 之觀察時長以「長於非 Maserati 之逾時」表述 —— **規格未給任一秒數**，故不造值（§8.4.1）。`source_clause` 取自 PDF p8 之 SU1.)（R-PMH50）。

tcs.tc_title: Maserati disclaimer screen exposes the comfort controls
tcs.test_item:
SU2.) For Maserati vehicles, while on the disclaimer screen the user will have access to their comfort controls.

(Maserati 且**未**配備 lower comfort screen —— 與 `-004` 之配備情形相對)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is a **Maserati** application
2. The vehicle is **not** equipped with the lower comfort screen
3. The disclaimer screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Observe the disclaimer screen for the comfort controls
2. Operate one of the comfort controls shown on the disclaimer screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The comfort controls are displayed on the disclaimer screen
2. The operated comfort control responds to the input
tcs.specification_reference: Power Moding HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 2A_7.2
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: P1 主要功能邏輯。**依 profile §4「變體即拆分」與 `-004` 成對** ——本條為未配備 lower comfort screen 之情形。變體詞 `Maserati` 逐字取自規格。`source_clause` 取自 PDF p8 之 SU2.)（R-PMH50）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 配備：未配備 lower comfort screen
tcs.source_clause: SU2.) For Maserati vehicles, while on the disclaimer screen the user will have access to their comfort controls. No timeout is provided for Maserati applications, see CFTS009.

tcs.tc_title: Comfort controls suppressed on Maserati disclaimer when the lower comfort screen is fitted
tcs.test_item:
SU2.1) Do not display comfort controls on Maserati disclaimer screen when vehicle is equipped with lower comfort screen.

(Maserati 且**已**配備 lower comfort screen —— 與 `-003` 之未配備情形相對)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The vehicle is a **Maserati** application
2. The vehicle **is** equipped with the lower comfort screen
3. The disclaimer screen is displayed
tcs.test_procedure: 1. Observe the disclaimer screen for the comfort controls
tcs.expected_result: 1. The comfort controls are not displayed on the disclaimer screen
tcs.specification_reference: Power Moding HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 2A_7.3
tcs.reasoning: P1 主要功能邏輯。**設計方法 NEG** —— 其標的為「不顯示」。與 `-003` 為 profile §4 之變體對（配備 vs 未配備 lower comfort screen）。變體詞 `Maserati`／`lower comfort screen` 逐字取自規格。`source_clause` 取自 PDF p8 之 SU2.1)（R-PMH50）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 配備：已配備 lower comfort screen
tcs.source_clause: SU2.1) Do not display comfort controls on Maserati disclaimer screen when vehicle is equipped with lower comfort screen.

tcs.tc_title: Pop-ups withheld until the disclaimer screen is removed while its audio still plays
tcs.test_item:
SU3.) No pop-ups will appear until the disclaimer screen has been removed. If an item like a traffic announcement is received the user will begin hearing the announcement in the background but will not see the pop-up until the disclaimer screen is removed.

(同一觸發之兩個必然後果 —— 視覺抑制與音訊照常，依 §5.7 不拆)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The disclaimer screen is displayed
2. A traffic announcement is available to be received
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Deliver a traffic announcement while the disclaimer screen is displayed and observe the screen and the audio output
2. Remove the disclaimer screen and observe the screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The traffic announcement is heard in the background and no pop-up is displayed over the disclaimer screen
2. The traffic announcement pop-up is displayed after the disclaimer screen is removed
tcs.specification_reference: Power Moding HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 2A_7.4
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.reasoning: P1 主要功能邏輯。**依 profile §4／canon §5.7「同一觸發之多個必然後果不拆」** ——「不顯示 pop-up」與「音訊照常播放」為同一觸發（免責畫面顯示中收到通告）之兩個必然後果，寫為同條之多行 ER。`source_clause` 取自 PDF p8 之 SU3.)（R-PMH50）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 同一觸發之兩後果：視覺抑制 ＋ 音訊照常
tcs.source_clause: SU3.) No pop-ups will appear until the disclaimer screen has been removed. If an item like a traffic announcement is received like on this screen the user will begin hearing the announcement in the background but will not see the pop-up until the disclaimer screen is removed.

tcs.tc_title: Power button to On displays the disclaimer screen
tcs.test_item:
Upon pressing the power button to On state the disclaimer screen shall be displayed (see SU6.) unless certain phone call scenarios have occurred.

(自 Power Button Off 轉 On 之進入路徑 —— 與 7.1 之開機序列進入路徑區辨)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The radio is in Power Button Off state
2. The ignition has gone from the OFF position to ACC or RUN
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press the power button to change the radio to On state
2. Observe the screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The radio changes to On state
2. The disclaimer screen is displayed
tcs.specification_reference: Power Moding HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 2A_10.4
tcs.reasoning: P1 主要功能邏輯。**設計方法 STATE** —— 其標的為 Power Button Off → On 之狀態轉換及其畫面。⚠ 規格之 `unless certain phone call scenarios have occurred` **未列舉該等情境**，故本條**不斷言其例外**，僅驗其正向路徑；該例外之列舉屬 10.6（`Power Off Behavior` 組），不在本批。`source_clause` 取自 PDF p10 之 PITA6.1（R-PMH50）。
tcs.distinguishing_axis: 進入路徑：Power Button Off → On
tcs.source_clause: PITA6.1: If radio is in Power Button Off state upon going from ignition in OFF position to ignition in ACC or RUN, HVAC popups shall display on the screen. Upon pressing power button to On state disclaimer screen shall be displayed (see SU6.) unless certain phone call scenarios have occurred.
